ci: install the agent code review action

PRs here carry no automated review, so `address-pr-reviews` halts at preflight
rather than reporting a clean pass on a reviewer that was never there. This is
the reviewer.

Pinned to the moving `@v1` tag so non-breaking releases arrive without a commit
here. `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` is provisioned into both the Actions and the
Dependabot secret stores — GitHub feeds Dependabot-triggered runs from the
separate store, and an Actions-only secret would leave every Dependabot PR
review silently unauthenticated.

Takes effect once it lands on master.

test(console,misc): clear the last 64 type errors; the gate is green

`makeConsole` typed its overrides as
`Parameters<typeof Console.prototype.constructor>[0]`, but
`Object.prototype.constructor` is plain `Function` in lib.es5 and carries no
construct signature — so the type collapsed to `undefined` and rejected every
options object. `ConsoleOptions` is the type it meant. Retyping it surfaced no
field drift underneath, so nothing in that file was passing vacuously.

Two findings the compiler could not have handed over on its own:

`Span.style` is `string | Style`, and `String.prototype` still carries the
legacy HTML wrappers — so `span.style.bold === true` type-checks against the
string arm and compares a function to `true`, an assertion that can never fire.
Satisfying the compiler would have preserved it; a `styleOf` parser narrows the
union once instead, and fails loudly with the span's range.

`OverlayStub` never declared the abstract `focusable`, so its instances carried
`undefined` where a boolean was required. It is declared `false`, which states
what was already true at runtime rather than changing behavior.

`npm run lint` now passes with `test/` included. Vitest unchanged: 1766 passed,
1 skipped.

test(text-input): brand the remaining offsets and settle the private-reach policy

Nine `cursorPosition` assignments with a computed right-hand side stayed raw
when the rest of this file was migrated; `value.length` and a row's
`valueStart` are both known code-point boundaries, so they route through
`asCodePoint`. The local `tinyHeadWrap` fixture now emits `WrapRow`.

The seven reaches into `_visualRows` / `_cursorVisualRow` are settled by
annotation, not by widening: they belong to white-box regression pins for a
cursor-motion boundary bug, and exposing permanent public API — plus the
deliberately-internal `VisualRow` — to make a disposable test compile is the
tail wagging the dog. Bracket access marks each reach, and one comment at the
head of the file states the rule for the next widget test.

test(cells,segment): brand the CellCol arguments in the cells and segment tests

Every raw number these two files passed as a width or position is a `CellCol` —
a terminal cell offset, the space `setCellSize`, `splitText`, `chopCells`, and
`Segment.splitCells` measure in. Route the literals through `asCellCol`, the
sanctioned constructor, at the point each one enters the test.

The two invariant tables convert at the fixture literal rather than inside the
loop, because the fixture is where the literal actually enters.

Brands erase at compile time, so this cannot move behavior: 1766 passed /
1 skipped, unchanged.

test(types): put test/ under the type-checker

Vitest transpiles through esbuild and never type-checks, so `test/` — the one
region that models real caller usage — was inspected by no compiler. A green
run had stopped being evidence that the tested API still exists in that shape.

`tsconfig.test.json` extends the root config and only widens the inspected
region; the two overrides are forced (the root pins `rootDir` to `src`, which
would reject `test/` outright, and test declarations have nowhere to go).

The gate is red on landing: 118 errors, recorded on rich-testing-5hp.1. The
sibling tickets on this branch clear them before it merges.

fix(coverage): label every allowlist entry by its actual export kind

Copilot review on PR #35 flagged that the reason string for KeyEvent
called it a "type" when src/widgets/types.ts declares it as a class.
A reader debugging a coverage failure consumes that reason string
verbatim — a wrong label is misleading guidance, not just imprecision.

The same pattern was repeated across many entries (I had labeled most
interfaces as "type" and several classes as "type"). Rather than
fix only the entry Copilot named, a derivation pass over src/ rewrote
every reason string from the actual export declaration:

  - class      → "<scope>: <Name> class"
  - interface  → "<scope>: <Name> interface"
  - type       → "<scope>: <Name> type alias"
  - const      → "<scope>: <Name> constant"
  - function   → "<scope>: <Name> function"
  - enum       → "<scope>: <Name> enum"

83 lines of labels updated. Existing parenthetical context (e.g.
"used transitively via Pretty") is preserved.

[LAW:one-source-of-truth] The src/ declaration is the canonical
description of an export's kind. A reason string that disagrees with
it is a divergent copy — fix the divergence by deriving from the
source, not by patching the copy point-by-point.

Verification: npm run lint clean; coverage verifier still green
(4/4).

chore(demos): retire flagship-per-domain spec and typing

Removes the artifacts that encoded the over-fit "exactly five flagships
with strict source-module ownership" model the previous demo-tune-up
design produced. The lit epic (rich-demos-l2x) has already been
rewritten back to the user's original ask (dedupe / expand / consolidate
/ reorganize / tweak — fewer + more interesting demos, with existing
working demos preserved until something better replaces them).

# Changes

- **Deleted `spec/demos.md`** — the 392-line spec that defined five
  flagships with rigid source-module ownership and mandated deleting the
  interactive TUIs (rich-explore, claude-sessions) to satisfy the count.
  Retired in favor of judgment-driven concrete improvements.

- **`test/coverage/coverage-allowlist.ts`** — dropped the `Flagship`
  string-literal union, the `burndown(flagship)` helper, and the
  discriminated-union `AllowlistEntry` (`{ kind: "burndown" }`
  vs `{ kind: "permanent" }`). Collapsed to one flat shape:
  `AllowlistEntry { reason: string }`. Per-flagship comment headers
  replaced with factual "-- from src/X --" sectioning. [LAW:absorbed-variance]
  — the discriminated union only had one realized case (burndown);
  collapse to one shape.

- **`test/coverage/coverage.test.ts`** — softened the file header
  comment (no longer claims to be "the keystone" of an epic; explicitly
  notes the verifier is a *floor*, not a quality measure). Updated the
  error messages and the redundant-entry detail to match the new
  AllowlistEntry shape.

- **`examples/themes-and-color-studio/index.ts`** — header comment no
  longer calls the demo "the flagship"; describes what it actually is
  (a printed-tour reference kept for the color subsystem, not a template
  for future demos). One-liner inside main() and one in-line infra
  comment updated to match.

# Verification

- npm run lint: clean
- npx vitest run: 8838 passed | 7 skipped (328 files)
- npm run themes-and-color-studio: runs to completion

# What is NOT changed

No demos under `examples/` are deleted. All existing demos
(`rich-explore`, `claude-sessions`, `rich-themes`, `rich-themes-transposed`,
`rich-theme-designer`, `rich-colors`, `rich-config`, `dropdown-demo`,
`rich-dash`, `rich-markup-plugins`, `rich-strip`, `rich-template-bindings`,
`themes-and-color-studio`, `shared`) remain on disk; their npm scripts
remain wired. Per parent epic non-goal: working demos are not deleted
before something concrete has replaced them and been judged a
replacement.
